# Chiplet_Based_Integration

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-22

## Definition
A packaging approach that combines multiple smaller dies (chiplets) with high-bandwidth die-to-die interfaces to build modular heterogeneous systems. It supports scalable iNEST neuromorphic accelerators and flexible TCC topology exploration.
